## About

Being able to demonstrate that your organisation has complied with applicable Corporate and Financial Legislation or Regulation is of paramount importance in today’s corporate world. Whether it be Anti-Bribery and Corruption, Anti-Money Laundering or Data Protection (to name only a few), non-compliance and the repercussions to your organisation are unthinkable.

Fincom Solutions™ can help you improve your Corporate and Financial Governance and help you build a Fully Compliant Culture with a Zero-Tolerance policy and when it comes to these types of compliance matters.

Our solutions are easy to implement, cost effective and offer real value for money. We offer a one stop solution for all your Corporate and Financial Compliance needs, from the initial phase of gap analysis through to full implementation of our easy to use Corporate Governance Platform.

We have worked with Fincom right at a year now and its automated OFAC processing platform has help our organization decrease the number of potential OFAC hits and decrease wire processing times. Fincom Technologies Limited (Fincom) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Service Cops Limited that has been created to run financial technology and e-commerce solutions that were formally run by Service Cops that fall under the NPS Act, 2020 regulation.

Service Cops Limited is an ISO 9001 & ISO 27001 financial Technology and Business Processes Outsourcing (BPO) solutions provider with over a decade experience creating financial technology and outsourcing solutions in the banking and financial services industry. It partners with 13 commercial banks, 3 telecoms, and number payments solutions providers, over 10,000 education institutions to offer a range of fintech especially digital finance solutions. It provides services in Uganda and in other markets beyond Uganda.

Fincom shall run independent operations but shall be authorized to use Service Cops proprietary financial technology and outsource a number of services and operations from Service Cops where necessary.
